caveats: The Q4 2023 value is derived (full-year minus nine-month year-to-date operating income), not a directly reported quarterly figure.
The full-year input is from accession 0001652044-26-000018 and the nine-month input is from accession 0001652044-24-000118.

claims.text: Alphabet's derived Q4 2023 operating income was about $23.70 billion ($23,697,000,000), calculated as FY2023 operating income of $84,293,000,000 minus the nine-month (Jan 1 to Sep 30, 2023) operating income of $60,596,000,000.

raw_output.summary: Alphabet's operating income in fiscal Q4 2023 (October 1 to December 31, 2023) was about $23.70 billion ($23,697,000,000). This is a derived value, calculated as FY2023 operating income of $84,293,000,000 minus the nine-month figure of $60,596,000,000.
